notes.title: Update - Improved Single Player Graphics
notes.content:
We have been working at improving the graphics on the single player levels.  Let us know what you think of the updates so far. http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=675980162

We are continuing to improve Yargis. We have added bigger and more exciting particles and effects. Also we have made it easier to add enemies in the Level editor (included in Yargis).

notes.title: Run Editor & Game Simultaneously
notes.content:
Level editor is now available in Library > Tools

Join game button now works!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=562358191&fileuploadsuccess=1
Join us in Yargis on Black Friday! And check the workshop for new levels.
[h1]Other enhancements:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Editor added OnInitialized: Fired when a level is initialized (runs every time, including in the editor loading).
    [*]Updated help. Editor icon updated.
    [*]Updated workshop to automatically update content subscriptions.
    [*]Fixed level 13 unlocked on overworld script error.
    [*]Added reset ship.
    [*]Added CoinMicro
    [*]Added text wrapping to descriptions.  Added DLC check and notice.
[/list]

notes.title: Top rated space game sale 40% OFF!
notes.content:
Yargis is a great game and with 40% off it is a must have!

Here are some of the features included in the latest version:
[list]
    [*]29 Single player levels
    [*]Over 10 multi-player levels
    [*]Workshop support - download new levels
    [*]Multiple players can compete on 1 screen
    [*]Level editor with drag and drop support
    [*]All levels are editable
    [*]Automatic transmission of custom levels
    [*]Controller support
    [*]Trading cards
    [*]You can even customize the 3D menu screen!
[/list] 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VpC9d659CxE

More info:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/369040/

notes.title: New Levels & Better Performance
notes.content:
We tweaked a few things to improve performance. Also, we added some new levels recently:
 [list]
    [*]DM Chopper - watch out for the blade :)
    [*]UC Arena - become Uber Charged and get quad damage!
    [*]Core Assault - try and blow up the enemy core - cool graphics
    [*]IV Hangar Invasion - stop the invasion
    [*]CO RandomBaseConquer - a Co-Op style, unlock the mazes
    [*]CTF Mukka Zima - classic capture the flag
[/list]

notes.title: Yargis - Space Melee - Full Workshop Support
notes.content:
Yargis - Space Melee allows you and your friends to create levels and game types and upload them into the Steam Workshop. It only takes 2 clicks, and your level will be shared with millions of Steam users!

[list]
[*]You can load your own images
[*]Easily play with others, levels are automatically downloaded
[*]Colorize your walls and 3D items
[*]Play your custom levels over the internet
[/list]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/369040/
